en: Ohhh... The glorious sun wheels across{SAUT}the sky...
While the birds a-twitter welcome it{SAUT}nigh.
And I behold it with mine worshipful{SAUT}eye...
What!? The voices came from these{SAUT}things!?

Yeah. They don't look dangerous, so{SAUT}might as well give it a go.
All right, show us how it's done.
Okay. Um... hey, uh, buddy. Bud! Hey,{SAUT}bud, you got a sec? We're lookin' for{SAUT}something.
You're a strange-looking flower.

I am NOT a "fair blossom"!
Praise the golden sun in the heavenly{SAUT}firmament!
There is no sun or heavenly firmament{SAUT}here! WILL YOU LISTEN!?
Sorry guys... But they're delusional...

D-Don't worry about it... hehe... At{SAUT}least you've still got your pollen-y hair.{PAGE}When you go bald you can just blame{SAUT}the bees for carrying your hair away.{PAGE}Hahaha! Oh, that's funny... *snort*{SAUT}BWHAHAHAHAHAHAHAHA!
Shut up, it's not THAT funny!
Oh, don't even try. Once Yukiko's been{SAUT}set off, there's no stopping her giggles.
Hey, why don't you let me handle this?{PAGE}With my powers of persuasion, I'll{SAUT}sweet-talk them into spilling the beans!

Well, I never! What an incredibly{SAUT}inappropriate thing to say!
Didn't your mother teach you any{SAUT}manners when you were a seed?
Huh? Wait, wha?
Back to singing! Ahem... When the rays{SAUT}shine down on me I rejoice...
Hey, come on! I just wanna ask about{SAUT}this thing we're looking for...
For time eternal, we all bask in this{SAUT}sun by choice.
Um... They're bein' really cagey...
What happened to your incredible{SAUT}powers of persuasion?
Dude, they can't be reasoned with!
Time to switch out! I'll go next!{PAGE}After all, I really honed my people skills{SAUT}at Junes.
Woooo! You go, Yosuke!
Watch and learn!{PAGE}WELLLLLLLCOME!
Hm, that always worked at Junes...{PAGE}I don't get it; they just kept singing{SAUT}those words. Which seem to be a{SAUT}metaphor for something...?
Maybe something in Hikari-chan's mind...{SAUT}But what're we supposed to do now?{PAGE}We're not getting anywhere at this rate.{SAUT}Anybody have any other bright ideas?
We don't have any other leads...{PAGE}We don't know anything else about the{SAUT}"black thing"...
Oh, you want to know about the black{SAUT}thing?
Well, well. Why didn't you just say so?
Oh, now they respond!?
Shut up, Yosuke! Hey, buds, what{SAUT}exactly is the "black thing"? Where can{SAUT}we find it?
Hehehehehe. The "black thing" was{SAUT}taken away.
And taken down below.
They wanted it all to themselves.
Um... I don't really get what they're{SAUT}saying, but basically there might be{SAUT}something down below?
Hikari, does this ring any bells for you?{PAGE}Or do you, like, sense anything{SAUT}underground?
Um... It's only a vague feeling, but I do{SAUT}sense something around here.
I can't explain it...
You don't have to. This whole movie is{SAUT}based on your mind, Hikari-san.{PAGE}We should investigate whatever feeling{SAUT}you get, no matter how vague.
Sit tight, Hikari-chan. We'll find{SAUT}whatever it is you're looking for.
Thank you so much... It's such a relief to{SAUT}have everyone's help.
So we gotta be sure to mention "black{SAUT}thing" wherever we go!{PAGE}After all, other flowers might know{SAUT}more about it. Let's try searching on{SAUT}the floor below this one!
